Class AetherisNotebookPanel.MoodGlassConnector

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel.MoodGlassConnector
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.jediterm.terminal.TtyConnector
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
private final class AetherisNotebookPanel.MoodGlassConnector extends Object implements com.jediterm.terminal.TtyConnector
The class MoodGlassConnector is the local terminal seam for the mood glass. The mood glass is the private terminal pane for the mood dialog. Keystrokes and reports stop here. This class does not call SshTtyConnector.write. The in-memory list moodTurns is the transcript. The glass paints that list. The connector keeps a line buffer, a pending output buffer, a control-sequence buffer, and a UTF-8 hold. The parse state is normal, escape, CSI, OSC, or SS3. The name CSI is a control sequence introduced by escape and [. The name OSC is an operating-system command introduced by escape and ]. The name SS3 is the single-shift sequence introduced by escape and O. A caller writes keystroke bytes through write(byte[]). A caller reads the painted screen through read(char[], int, int). A closed connector refuses further writes. A closed connector returns end of input from read(char[], int, int) when nothing is still pending.

    • takeLine

      private String takeLine()
      The method returns the current line when its trim is not empty. The method then clears the line buffer. A line whose trim is empty stays in the buffer. That empty trim returns null.

    • dropLine

    • paintTranscript

      private void paintTranscript()
      The method paints the list, then the prompt and the uncommitted line, in one append. A closed connector returns without painting. The screen starts with the clear-screen sequence and the cursor-home sequence. Each turn is painted by paintTurn(StringBuilder, String, String). The prompt is the green text > . The uncommitted line is passed through visible(String). The finished screen is appended to the pending buffer. The method notifies a reader waiting in read(char[], int, int).

    • paintTurn

      private void paintTurn(StringBuilder screen, String role, String text)
      The method appends one turn to the paint buffer. you and assistant are the only colored role marks. A role user is painted as you in green. A role assistant is painted as assistant in the assistant color. Any other role is painted as the role text with no color. The role line ends with a carriage return and a line feed. The turn text is passed through visible(String). Rows are split on \r\n. An assistant row that AetherisNotebookPanel.moodMarks(String) accepts is painted yellow. A yellow row is a mood line. Every other row is painted with no extra color. The turn ends with a blank line.
      Parameters:
      screen - The screen is the paint buffer this turn is appended to.
      role - The role is the list role for this turn.
      text - The text is the turn text.

    • read

      public int read(char[] buf, int offset, int length) throws IOException
      The method copies pending characters into buf. The method waits 200 milliseconds at a time while the pending buffer is empty and the connector is open. An interrupt ends that wait when the connector is closed. An interrupt while the connector is open continues the wait. An empty pending buffer returns -1. Otherwise the copy length is the smaller of length and the pending length. Those characters are deleted from the pending buffer.
      Specified by:
      read in interface com.jediterm.terminal.TtyConnector
      Parameters:
      buf - The buf is the destination array.
      offset - The offset is the first index written in buf.
      length - The length is the most characters this call copies.
      Returns:
      The method returns the count copied, or -1 when nothing is pending.
      Throws:
      IOException - The signature declares IOException, and this body does not throw it.

    • feedChar

      private void feedChar(char c, boolean bulk)
      The method parses one character into the line or into a control state. bulk is true when the decoded text was longer than one character. An escape state returns to normal before the character is classified. [ starts a CSI sequence and clears the CSI buffer. ] starts an OSC sequence and clears the OSC escape flag. O starts an SS3 sequence. Any other character in the escape state is dropped. An SS3 state drops the character and returns to normal. A CSI final byte from 0x40 through 0x7E ends the sequence and clears the parameter buffer. A tilde whose parameters are 200 or ?200 sets paste mode. A tilde whose parameters are 201 or ?201 clears paste mode. Any other CSI final byte is ignored. A CSI parameter buffer shorter than 32 characters appends this character. A longer CSI buffer is cleared and the state returns to normal. An OSC byte 0x07 or 0x9C ends the sequence. A backslash after an escape also ends the sequence. Any other OSC character is dropped. An escape byte in OSC sets the OSC escape flag. Any other OSC byte clears that flag. A normal escape byte starts the escape state and clears the carriage-return flag. Backspace or delete calls backspace() and clears the carriage-return flag. A carriage return or a line feed during paste or bulk appends one newline, except a line feed that follows a carriage return. That following line feed is skipped so the pair is one break. The appended break is echoed as \r\n. A carriage return or a line feed outside paste and bulk calls queueEnter() and does not append. A character below 0x20 is dropped. Any other character is appended to the line and echoed.
      Parameters:
      c - The c is the character to parse.
      bulk - The bulk flag is true when this character came from a text longer than one character.

    • decode

      private String decode(byte[] bytes)
      The method turns bytes into a string and holds a trailing incomplete UTF-8 sequence. Bytes held from the last call are placed in front of bytes. utfCut(byte[]) chooses how many leading bytes form complete characters. The uncut tail is stored in the hold. A cut of 0 returns an empty string. A cut of the whole array decodes the whole array as UTF-8. Any other positive cut decodes only that prefix as UTF-8.
      Parameters:
      bytes - The bytes are the new keystroke bytes, without the earlier hold.
      Returns:
      The method returns the complete UTF-8 text, or an empty string when no character is complete.

    • utfCut

      private int utfCut(byte[] all)
      The method returns the length of the complete UTF-8 prefix of all. A byte below 0x80 needs 1 byte. A byte from 0xC2 through 0xDF needs 2 bytes. A byte from 0xE0 through 0xEF needs 3 bytes. A byte from 0xF0 through 0xF4 needs 4 bytes. Any other lead byte is skipped, and the cut moves past it. A sequence that would run past the array returns the cut before that sequence. A finished array returns the full length.
      Parameters:
      all - The all array is the held bytes plus the new bytes.
      Returns:
      The method returns the number of leading bytes that form complete characters.

    • visible

      private String visible(String text)
      The method returns the text the glass may paint. A null text returns an empty string. An empty text returns an empty string. A carriage return is remembered and is not copied yet. A line feed becomes \r\n and clears that memory. A remembered carriage return before another character also becomes \r\n. A tab becomes one space. An escape or a character below 0x20 is dropped. Any other character is kept. A trailing remembered carriage return becomes \r\n.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the raw line or turn text.
      Returns:
      The method returns the painted text, or an empty string when text is null or empty.
